preconditions.description: Input S must be a non-empty string with length between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(S[i] == S[j] for i, j in zip(range(len(return_value)), range(len(return_value)-1, -1, -1)))
postconditions.description: The returned substring must be a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(S[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if all(S[k] == S[i+j-k] for k in range(i, j+1)))
postconditions.description: The returned substring must be the longest possible palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: S.find(return_value) == min(S.find(S[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if all(S[k] == S[i+j-k] for k in range(i, j+1)))
postconditions.description: In case of multiple substrings of the same maximum length, the one with the smallest starting index must be returned.
